parameters.parameter_family: team count, active roster size, scoring, draft rounds, lineup/FLEX/Superflex/K/DST eligibility, playoff team count/start, division seeding and standard 4/6/8 bracket structure
parameters.source: Synced Sleeper league and roster configuration plus Sleeper-defined standard playoff/division rules
parameters.validation: Configuration consistency plus synthetic portability regressions for alternate team counts, lineups, draft rounds and 4/6/8-team playoff structures
parameters.update_policy: Update from synced league settings for encoded rules; verify external semantics before enabling undocumented or nonstandard playoff round codes.
parameters.notes: FSFFL remains the regression league, not the architecture. The future-pick planning horizon is separately treated as provisional runtime scope.

parameters.parameter_family: player scoring means and source weights
parameters.source: Current external projection source(s), recalculated under FSFFL scoring
parameters.validation: Required: rolling historical out-of-sample source/ensemble accuracy by position and horizon
parameters.uncertainty: Not yet demonstrated for projection mean layer
parameters.update_policy: Re-estimate source weights when new completed-season/week evidence is available; promote only on holdout improvement

parameters.source: Historical realized weekly scoring dispersion is used as a proxy for forecast uncertainty; position floors, shrinkage, Normal distribution shape, median offset and non-bye availability remain heuristic
parameters.validation: Required: archived forecast residual calibration/coverage tests by position and forecast horizon; realized-score dispersion alone is not forecast-error validation
parameters.uncertainty: Material: cross-player/outcome dispersion is not equivalent to conditional forecast residual variance
parameters.update_policy: Replace proxy dispersion with versioned residual-based estimates when archived forecasts exist; challenger must improve held-out distributional calibration

parameters.parameter_family: current production, future value, liquidity and resilience weights
parameters.source: Versioned data/gm/state_weight_calibration.json expert-prior artifact containing the legacy GM anchors; empirically_validated=false
parameters.validation: Required: real versioned training artifact plus temporal/holdout validation and sensitivity analysis
parameters.uncertainty: high until a historical training artifact demonstrates out-of-sample improvement over the expert prior
parameters.update_policy: Treat as a bounded Simulator-indexed expert prior; refine via sensitivity/simulation evidence when stronger than legacy anchors, and reserve empirical-promotion labels for temporal holdout improvement.

parameters.source: FantasyCalc overall rank derived from the same external dynasty market anchor
parameters.validation: No incremental use active. Reintroduction requires frozen contemporaneous market values and held-out residual improvement beyond the market anchor.
parameters.uncertainty: Prior implementation re-priced the external market from its own rank and risked double counting elite/depth pricing; the incremental rank curve is now inactive.
parameters.update_policy: Keep inactive unless a versioned residual model demonstrates stable out-of-sample incremental value.
parameters.notes: Market rank may remain descriptive but does not reprice the anchor.

parameters.component: Strategic valuation adjustments inherited by GM 3.0
parameters.parameter_family: need, preference, window, endowment, starter/depth, performance, usage, injury and utility adjustments
parameters.source: Legacy owner-specific need/preference/window/endowment/starter/depth/pick multipliers and hand-set recent-performance/usage/snap/injury/manual-news percentage repricing are preserved diagnostically but no longer alter the market-anchored dynasty value. Continuous GM3 utility, canonical projections/Simulator, and Behavioral Intelligence own those concepts in their appropriate downstream roles.
parameters.validation: Structural overlap reduction complete for owner-specific and football-market repricing multipliers. Reintroduction of any incremental market-value overlay requires residual time-ordered evidence versus the contemporaneous market anchor and canonical projections.
parameters.uncertainty: The legacy coefficients remain uncertain but have no incremental valuation authority. Football signals remain available for explanation and can be promoted later if they demonstrate information not already contained in market/projection inputs.
parameters.update_policy: Keep legacy multipliers diagnostic. Re-estimate and re-enable an individual family only if versioned time-ordered residual validation demonstrates incremental predictive/decision value.

parameters.parameter_family: 30-day external market trend layered onto current external dynasty market value
parameters.source: FantasyCalc current dynasty value plus FantasyCalc 30-day trend signal
parameters.validation: Required: time-ordered residual test showing that the trend adjustment improves future FSFFL-relevant value or decision accuracy beyond the current market anchor alone
parameters.uncertainty: current market value may already incorporate the information that created the recent price move
parameters.update_policy: Retain only if incremental held-out value over the current market anchor is demonstrated; otherwise remove the second market-on-market adjustment

parameters.parameter_family: future discount, tier multipliers, pick-slot scenarios, uncertainty growth and own-pick control
parameters.source: Future-pick base values use observed/extrapolated external early/mid/late market cells. The original team's canonical Simulator competitive percentile continuously interpolates between those market anchors, replacing the legacy hard contender-score tier cliff. Pick uncertainty remains scenario bounds; uncertainty, liquidity, own-pick control and duplicate quality/optionality premiums do not add incremental value.
parameters.validation: Near-term point estimate is grounded in canonical Simulator competitive ordering plus current external pick-market structure. Historical frozen forecast-to-realized-slot cohorts are still required to validate persistence across longer horizons and calibrate predictive intervals.
parameters.uncertainty: Future team strength can change materially, especially for 2028-2029. Early/mid/late market cells are exposed as uncertainty bounds; the point estimate does not claim calibrated slot probability.
parameters.update_policy: Re-estimate continuously from each canonical Simulator refresh and current external market cells. When enough frozen historical cohorts exist, validate/calibrate horizon persistence and interval coverage out of sample.
parameters.notes: Legacy discrete early/mid/late valuation cliff replaced by continuous market interpolation over Simulator competitive percentile.

parameters.parameter_family: effective value weights for second/third assets, roster-slot drag, replacement relief and consolidation effects
parameters.source: High-recall package prescreen plus GM2.2 nonlinear package curve; exact roster legalization supplies actual forced-cut cost
parameters.validation: Required: package-economics residual validation from frozen contemporaneous value snapshots. Generic slot penalty remains inactive because actual cut burden is modeled directly.
parameters.uncertainty: Consolidation/package weights and liquidity adjustment remain uncalibrated; generic roster-slot double counting has been structurally removed.
parameters.update_policy: Keep exact roster-cut cost canonical and represent package economics across a governed uncertainty set of plausible curves; narrow/promote only with valid held-out transaction evidence.
parameters.notes: The former 3.5% extra-asset slot penalty is zero because forced cuts are explicitly legalized and valued downstream.

parameters.source: Retention-cost prescreen plus exact tractable final focal cut-plan enumeration scored through the canonical downstream Trade Score
parameters.validation: Final focal candidates enumerate all legal cut plans when the combination count is <=27 using 1,000-simulation common-random-number screening, then rerun the selected plan at the canonical final simulation count. Large plan spaces and non-focal cut choices retain the governed prescreen.
parameters.uncertainty: Final focal one-cut cases are usually exact; large combinatorial plan spaces and counterparty cuts can still depend on retention-cost ordering.
parameters.update_policy: Expand exact/top-k final-plan search where runtime remains acceptable; retain prescreen only as search acceleration/fallback, not unquestioned final authority.
parameters.notes: Structural refinement first pass: retention-cost ordering no longer has final authority for tractable focal cut-plan spaces.

parameters.parameter_family: pair insurance, capture scale, portfolio adjustment and acceptance-fit shift
parameters.source: Same-team/position interaction context and proposed pair-insurance value remain available diagnostically. Incremental final-score and acceptance adjustments are disabled because GM3 already models team-specific replacement resilience through lineup reoptimization.
parameters.validation: Reintroduction requires incremental evidence that pair-insurance improves simulated or historical lineup-availability outcomes beyond existing replacement-resilience modeling.
parameters.uncertainty: The pair-insurance formula remains bounded but uncalibrated; because it is diagnostic-only it cannot change authoritative ranking.
parameters.update_policy: Use canonical simulation/replacement-outcome evidence to estimate incremental interaction value. Re-enable only if it adds stable value beyond existing resilience.

parameters.parameter_family: source weights, smoothing, positional preference blend, residual scaling and confidence curve
parameters.source: Observed manager actions use adaptive shrinkage and confidence-weighted integration. Behavioral evidence informs descriptive counterparty context but has zero separate valuation or negotiation-ranking weight.
parameters.validation: Required for empirical promotion: time-ordered held-out manager-action prediction versus simple league/need baselines plus family ablations. Current shrinkage is a stronger sparse-data estimator, not a calibrated acceptance probability.
parameters.uncertainty: Manager samples remain sparse/non-stationary; shrinkage automatically reduces manager-specific authority when evidence is thin.
parameters.update_policy: Re-estimate adaptive shrinkage on every refreshed action history using the current league effective-sample distribution; empirical promotion still requires recency-aware held-out ranking/log-loss improvement.

parameters.parameter_family: state-specific title/value floors, fit-score coefficients, HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW bands and behavioral/roster-fit shifts
parameters.source: Counterparty economic feasibility uses the sign of shared continuous buyer utility. HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW Behavioral Intelligence fit remains descriptive only and has zero incremental trade-quality or negotiation-ranking weight.
parameters.validation: Buyer-utility consistency is structurally testable now. Literal acceptance probability still requires a defensible accepted/rejected or choice-opportunity denominator and time-ordered validation.
parameters.uncertainty: Literal acceptance probability remains uncalibrated, but acceptance bands and categorical state thresholds no longer carry ranking/valuation authority.
parameters.update_policy: Keep buyer feasibility tied to shared decision utility and acceptance fit diagnostic. Calibrate probability/ranking influence only when a valid offer/choice denominator exists.

parameters.parameter_family: full candidate universe, market-distance simulation priority, descriptive plausibility bands and diversified shortlist
parameters.source: Full owned tradeable asset pool and all plausibility bands are retained. Expensive simulation is prioritized by absolute log distance between market-anchored package values, then focal market/redraft surplus; legacy protected-asset, need, redraft and value-ratio coefficient stacks no longer determine prescreen order.
parameters.validation: Full-pool/full-band recall regression remains active. Downstream canonical simulation/utility determines trade quality; prescreen only allocates computation.
parameters.uncertainty: Any finite simulation shortlist can miss a useful market-outlier package, but arbitrary cross-signal prescreen coefficients and band eligibility gates no longer create that risk.
parameters.update_policy: Benchmark shortlist recall against expanded downstream simulation where tractable. Increase/optimize compute coverage rather than reintroducing unsupported weighted prescreen heuristics.

parameters.parameter_family: championship-probability and value thresholds for accept/lean/reject
parameters.source: Legacy Decision Lab uses threshold-free Pareto direction over Simulator competitive outcomes plus market-dynasty value. Competitive-state labels are descriptive only; production Trade Decision remains authoritative.
parameters.validation: Structural invariant: no fixed championship/value accept/lean/reject thresholds remain in the legacy Decision Lab classifier.
parameters.uncertainty: Mixed tradeoffs intentionally remain needs_context and are resolved by the canonical production decision utility rather than a legacy cutoff.
parameters.update_policy: Do not reintroduce numeric recommendation cliffs. Keep this compatibility path conservative and defer mixed decisions to canonical Trade Decision.

parameters.parameter_family: state weights, diminishing returns and guardrails
parameters.source: GM3 Team Improvement consumes Shared Decision Utility 2.0: canonical Simulator league-relative current impact plus market-anchored future value and direct value-denominated liquidity/resilience, with continuous Simulator-indexed objective weights.
parameters.validation: Structural convergence and fixed-unit-scale removal complete. Empirical promotion still requires time-ordered outcome/choice validation of objective-state tradeoffs.
parameters.uncertainty: No separate Team Improvement ranking coefficients or categorical guardrails remain; uncertainty is inherited from Simulator/market inputs and governed objective-state preferences.
parameters.update_policy: Re-estimate data-derived scales automatically through the shared utility; refit only objective-state preference weights if stronger held-out evidence supports it.

parameters.parameter_family: league-relative simulated current utility, market-dynasty future value, direct value-denominated liquidity and replacement resilience, governed continuous objective weights
parameters.source: Current impact is the median of canonical Simulator outcome deltas normalized by baseline league means and converted to value units by the focal roster's observed market-redraft scale. Future value remains market-dynasty delta; liquidity/resilience remain value-denominated. Fixed title/playoff/wins/points/optionality/liquidity/resilience/externality conversion constants are removed.
parameters.validation: Required for empirical promotion: time-ordered historical decision/outcome or choice validation against simpler baselines. Structural unit scaling is now data-derived rather than hand-set.
parameters.uncertainty: Remaining uncertainty is primarily the normative continuous objective-state weights and model-input uncertainty, not arbitrary cross-unit conversion constants.
parameters.update_policy: Re-estimate league-relative scales automatically from each canonical baseline simulation; update market value scales with refreshed market data; refit objective-state preference weights only with stronger evidence and holdout validation.
parameters.notes: Fixed unit-conversion coefficients removed; correlated current outcomes are combined by an unweighted median to avoid coefficient selection and reduce double counting.

parameters.parameter_family: counterfactual branch probabilities and decision policies
parameters.source: Known historical facts plus model-generated counterfactual decisions
parameters.validation: Validate factual inputs, no-hindsight information firewall, deterministic mechanics, sensitivity and probability calibration where observable; unknowable branches remain explicitly modeled inference
parameters.update_policy: Preserve functionality; improve evidence and calibration as historical analogues/data expand; never relabel modeled branches as historical fact

parameters.component: Market-tier scarcity versus roster replacement value
parameters.parameter_family: market-value percentile/tier-gap signal, roster-specific lineup replacement drop, and any incremental scarcity premium
parameters.source: FantasyCalc dynasty values for descriptive market tier; current roster and legal-lineup reoptimization for replacement sensitivity
parameters.validation: Market-tier signal may remain descriptive, but incremental price/utility effect requires held-out residual evidence beyond the external market anchor. Roster replacement sensitivity is recomputed from the current legal roster.
parameters.uncertainty: Market prices already embed positional scarcity, so market percentile/tier gaps can double count if rewarded again. Replacement sensitivity is current-roster evidence, not an injury probability or long-run WAR estimate.
parameters.update_policy: Keep market-tier scarcity diagnostic-only unless incremental validation succeeds; preserve roster-specific replacement calculations.
parameters.notes: Structural de-duplication removes market-tier scarcity from incremental GM premiums without changing projection means or uncertainty.
